title: August and the Undertow
author: T. M. Thackeray
blurb: Rosalind Brightwater, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
